mip_version.description: MUST match this document's own version string exactly, including a -draft suffix while one is carried.

oauth_token_endpoint.description: REQUIRED in this document if the RP supports §6.1's client-held-token variant; omitted otherwise.

jwks_uri.description: REQUIRED if the RP issues JWT session tokens (§7.2); omitted otherwise.

session_refresh_endpoint.description: REQUIRED if the RP supports §9; omitted otherwise.

session_revoke_endpoint.description: REQUIRED if the RP uses opaque tokens or otherwise supports §7.4; omitted otherwise.

userinfo_endpoint.description: REQUIRED if the RP supports §7.5; omitted otherwise.

supports_linking.description: OPTIONAL. MAY be explicitly false rather than only omitted. An RP supporting §10.2 MUST set true.
